passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.1
passages.text: Spero me secutum in libellis meis tale temperamen-

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.2
passages.text: tum, ut de illis queri non possit quisquis de se bene

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.3
passages.text: senserit, cum salva infimarum quoque personarum re-

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.4
passages.text: verentia ludant; quae adeo antiquis auctoribus defuit, ut

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.5
passages.text: nominibus non tantum veris abusi sint, sed et magnis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.6
passages.text: Mihi fama vilius constet et probetur in me novissimum

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.7
passages.text: ingenium. Absit a iocorum nostrorum simplicitate ma-

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.8
passages.text: lignus interpres nec epigrammata mea scribat: inprobe

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.9
passages.text: facit qui in alieno libro ingeniosus est. Lascivam ver-

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.10
passages.text: borum veritatem, id est epigrammaton linguam, excu-

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.11
passages.text: sarem, si meum esset exemplum: sic scribit Catullus, sic

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.12
passages.text: Marsus, sic Pedo, sic Gaetulicus, sic quicumque perlegi-

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.13
passages.text: tur. Si quis tamen tam ambitiose tristis est, ut apud

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.14
passages.text: illum in nulla pagina latine loqui fas sit, potest epistula

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.15
passages.text: vel potius titulo contentus esse. Epigrammata illis scri-

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.16
passages.text: buntur, qui solent spectare Florales. Non intret Cato

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.17
passages.text: theatrum meum, aut si intraverit, spectet. Videor mihi

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.18
passages.text: meo iure facturus, si epistulam versibus clusero:

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.19
passages.text: Nosses iocosae dulce cum sacrum Florae

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.20
passages.text: Festosque lusus et licentiam volgi,

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.21
passages.text: Cur in theatrum, Cato severe, venisti?

passages.label: Mart. 1.pr.22
passages.text: An ideo tantum veneras, ut exires?

passages.label: Mart. 1.1.1
passages.text: Hic est quem legis ille, quem requiris,

passages.label: Mart. 1.1.2
passages.text: Toto notus in orbe Martialis

passages.label: Mart. 1.1.3
passages.text: Argutis epigrammaton libellis:

passages.label: Mart. 1.1.4
passages.text: Cui, lector studiose, quod dedisti

passages.label: Mart. 1.1.5
passages.text: Viventi decus atque sentienti,

passages.label: Mart. 1.1.6
passages.text: Rari post cineres habent poetae.

passages.label: Mart. 1.2.1
passages.text: Qui tecum cupis esse meos ubicumque libellos

passages.label: Mart. 1.2.2
passages.text: Et comites longae quaeris habere viae,

passages.label: Mart. 1.2.3
passages.text: Hos eme, quos artat brevibus membrana tabellis:

passages.label: Mart. 1.2.4
passages.text: Scrinia da magnis, me manus una capit.

passages.label: Mart. 1.2.5
passages.text: Ne tamen ignores ubi sim venalis, et erres

passages.label: Mart. 1.2.6
passages.text: Urbe vagus tota, me duce certus eris:

passages.label: Mart. 1.2.7
passages.text: Libertum docti Lucensis quaere Secundum

passages.label: Mart. 1.2.8
passages.text: Limina post Pacis Palladiumque forum.

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.1
passages.text: Argiletanas mavis habitare tabernas,

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.2
passages.text: Cum tibi, parve liber, scrinia nostra vacent.

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.3
passages.text: Nescis, heu, nescis dominae fastidia Romae:

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.4
passages.text: Crede mihi, nimium Martia turba sapit.

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.5
passages.text: Maiores nusquam rhonchi: iuvenesque senesque

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.6
passages.text: Et pueri nasum rhinocerotis habent.

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.7
passages.text: Audieris cum grande sophos, dum basia iactas,

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.8
passages.text: Ibis ab excusso missus in astra sago.

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.9
passages.text: Sed tu ne totiens domini patiare lituras

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.10
passages.text: Neve notet lusus tristis harundo tuos,

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.11
passages.text: Aetherias, lascive, cupis volitare per auras:

passages.label: Mart. 1.3.12
passages.text: I, fuge; sed poteras tutior esse domi.

passages.label: Mart. 1.4.1
passages.text: Contigeris nostros, Caesar, si forte libellos,

passages.label: Mart. 1.4.2
passages.text: Terrarum dominum pone supercilium.

passages.label: Mart. 1.4.3
passages.text: Consuevere iocos vestri quoque ferre triumphi,

passages.label: Mart. 1.4.4
passages.text: Materiam dictis nec pudet esse ducem.

passages.label: Mart. 1.4.5
passages.text: Qua Thymelen spectas derisoremque Latinum,

passages.label: Mart. 1.4.6
passages.text: Illa fronte precor carmina nostra legas.

passages.label: Mart. 1.4.7
passages.text: Innocuos censura potest permittere lusus:

passages.label: Mart. 1.4.8
passages.text: Lasciva est nobis pagina, vita proba.

passages.label: Mart. 1.5.1
passages.text: Do tibi naumachiam, tu das epigrammata nobis:

passages.label: Mart. 1.5.2
passages.text: Vis, puto, cum libro, Marce, natare tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 1.6.1
passages.text: Aetherias aquila puerum portante per auras

passages.label: Mart. 1.6.2
passages.text: Inlaesum timidis unguibus haesit onus:

passages.label: Mart. 1.6.3
passages.text: Nunc sua Caesareos exorat praeda leones,

passages.label: Mart. 1.6.4
passages.text: Tutus et ingenti ludit in ore lepus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.6.5
passages.text: Quae maiora putas miracula? summus utrisque

passages.label: Mart. 1.6.6
passages.text: Auctor adest: haec sunt Caesaris, illa Iovis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.7.1
passages.text: Stellae delicium mei Columba,

passages.label: Mart. 1.7.2
passages.text: Verona licet audiente dicam,

passages.label: Mart. 1.7.3
passages.text: Vicit, Maxime, Passerem Catulli.

passages.label: Mart. 1.7.4
passages.text: Tanto Stella meus tuo Catullo

passages.label: Mart. 1.7.5
passages.text: Quanto passere maior est columba.

passages.label: Mart. 1.8.1
passages.text: Quod magni Thraseae consummatique Catonis

passages.label: Mart. 1.8.2
passages.text: Dogmata sic sequeris, salvos ut esse velis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.8.3
passages.text: Pectore nec nudo strictos incurris in ensis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.8.4
passages.text: Quod fecisse velim te, Deciane, facis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.8.5
passages.text: Nolo virum facili redimit qui sanguine famam,

passages.label: Mart. 1.8.6
passages.text: Hunc volo, laudari qui sine morte potest.

passages.label: Mart. 1.9.1
passages.text: Bellus homo et magnus vis idem, Cotta, videri:

passages.label: Mart. 1.9.2
passages.text: Sed qui bellus homo est, Cotta, pusillus homo est.

passages.label: Mart. 1.10.1
passages.text: Petit Gemellus nuptias Maronillae

passages.label: Mart. 1.10.2
passages.text: Et cupit et instat et precatur et donat.

passages.label: Mart. 1.10.3
passages.text: Adeone pulchra est? immo foedius nil est.

passages.label: Mart. 1.10.4
passages.text: Quid ergo in illa petitur et placet? Tussit.

passages.label: Mart. 1.11.1
passages.text: Cum data sint equiti bis quina nomismata, quare

passages.label: Mart. 1.11.2
passages.text: Bis decies solus, Sextiliane, bibis?

passages.label: Mart. 1.11.3
passages.text: Iam defecisset portantis calda ministros,

passages.label: Mart. 1.11.4
passages.text: Si non potares, Sextiliane, merum.

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.1
passages.text: Itur ad Herculeas gelidi qua Tiburis arces

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.2
passages.text: Canaque sulphureis Albula fumat aquis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.3
passages.text: Rura nemusque sacrum dilectaque iugera Musis

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.4
passages.text: Signat vicina quartus ab urbe lapis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.5
passages.text: Hic rudis aestivas praestabat porticus umbras,

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.6
passages.text: Heu quam paene novum porticus ausa nefas!

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.7
passages.text: Nam subito conlapsa ruit, cum mole sub illa

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.8
passages.text: Gestatus biiugis Regulus esset equis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.9
passages.text: Nimirum timuit nostras Fortuna querellas,

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.10
passages.text: Quae par tam magnae non erat invidiae.

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.11
passages.text: Nunc et damna iuvant; sunt ipsa pericula tanti:

passages.label: Mart. 1.12.12
passages.text: Stantia non poterant tecta probare deos.

passages.label: Mart. 1.13.1
passages.text: Casta suo gladium cum traderet Arria Paeto,

passages.label: Mart. 1.13.2
passages.text: Quem de visceribus strinxerat ipsa suis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.13.3
passages.text: 'Si qua fides, vulnus quod feci non dolet,' inquit,

passages.label: Mart. 1.13.4
passages.text: 'Sed tu quod facies, hoc mihi, Paete, dolet.'

passages.label: Mart. 1.14.1
passages.text: Delicias, Caesar, lususque iocosque leonum

passages.label: Mart. 1.14.2
passages.text: Vidimus—hoc etiam praestat harena tibi—

passages.label: Mart. 1.14.3
passages.text: Cum prensus blando totiens a dente rediret

passages.label: Mart. 1.14.4
passages.text: Et per aperta vagus curreret ora lepus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.14.5
passages.text: Unde potest avidus captae leo parcere praedae?

passages.label: Mart. 1.14.6
passages.text: Sed tamen esse tuus dicitur: ergo potest.

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.1
passages.text: O mihi post nullos, Iuli, memorande sodales,

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.2
passages.text: Si quid longa fides canaque iura valent,

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.3
passages.text: Bis iam paene tibi consul tricensimus instat,

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.4
passages.text: Et numerat paucos vix tua vita dies.

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.5
passages.text: Non bene distuleris videas quae posse negari,

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.6
passages.text: Et solum hoc ducas, quod fuit, esse tuum.

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.7
passages.text: Expectant curaeque catenatique labores,

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.8
passages.text: Gaudia non remanent, sed fugitiva volant.

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.9
passages.text: Haec utraque manu conplexuque adsere toto:

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.10
passages.text: Saepe fluunt imo sic quoque lapsa sinu.

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.11
passages.text: Non est, crede mihi, sapientis dicere 'Vivam':

passages.label: Mart. 1.15.12
passages.text: Sera nimis vita est crastina: vive hodie.

passages.label: Mart. 1.16.1
passages.text: Sunt bona, sunt quaedam mediocria, sunt mala plura

passages.label: Mart. 1.16.2
passages.text: Quae legis hic: aliter non fit, Avite, liber.

passages.label: Mart. 1.17.1
passages.text: Cogit me Titus actitare causas

passages.label: Mart. 1.17.2
passages.text: Et dicit mihi saepe 'Magna res est.'

passages.label: Mart. 1.17.3
passages.text: Res magna est, Tite, quam facit colonus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.18.1
passages.text: Quid te, Tucca, iuvat vetulo miscere Falerno

passages.label: Mart. 1.18.2
passages.text: In Vaticanis condita musta cadis?

passages.label: Mart. 1.18.3
passages.text: Quid tantum fecere boni tibi pessima vina?

passages.label: Mart. 1.18.4
passages.text: Aut quid fecerunt optima vina mali?

passages.label: Mart. 1.18.5
passages.text: De nobis facile est, scelus est iugulare Falernum

passages.label: Mart. 1.18.6
passages.text: Et dare Campano toxica saeva mero.

passages.label: Mart. 1.18.7
passages.text: Convivae meruere tui fortasse perire:

passages.label: Mart. 1.18.8
passages.text: Amphora non meruit tam pretiosa mori.

passages.label: Mart. 1.19.1
passages.text: Si memini, fuerant tibi quattuor, Aelia, dentes:

passages.label: Mart. 1.19.2
passages.text: Expulit una duos tussis et una duos.

passages.label: Mart. 1.19.3
passages.text: Iam secura potes totis tussire diebus:

passages.label: Mart. 1.19.4
passages.text: Nil istic quod agat tertia tussis habet.

passages.label: Mart. 1.20.1
passages.text: Dic mihi, quis furor est? turba spectante vocata

passages.label: Mart. 1.20.2
passages.text: Solus boletos, Caeciliane, voras.

passages.label: Mart. 1.20.3
passages.text: Quid dignum tanto tibi ventre gulaque precabor?

passages.label: Mart. 1.20.4
passages.text: Boletum qualem Claudius edit, edas.

passages.label: Mart. 1.21.1
passages.text: Cum peteret regem, decepta satellite dextra

passages.label: Mart. 1.21.2
passages.text: Ingessit sacris se peritura focis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.21.3
passages.text: Sed tam saeva pius miracula non tulit hostis

passages.label: Mart. 1.21.4
passages.text: Et raptum flammis iussit abire virum:

passages.label: Mart. 1.21.5
passages.text: Urere quam potuit contempto Mucius igne,

passages.label: Mart. 1.21.6
passages.text: Hanc spectare manum Porsena non potuit.

passages.label: Mart. 1.21.7
passages.text: Maior deceptae fama est et gloria dextrae:

passages.label: Mart. 1.21.8
passages.text: Si non errasset, fecerat illa minus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.22.1
passages.text: Quid nunc saeva fugis placidi lepus ora leonis?

passages.label: Mart. 1.22.2
passages.text: Frangere tam parvas non didicere feras.

passages.label: Mart. 1.22.3
passages.text: Servantur magnis isti cervicibus ungues

passages.label: Mart. 1.22.4
passages.text: Nec gaudet tenui sanguine tanta sitis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.22.5
passages.text: Praeda canum lepus est, vastos non implet hiatus

passages.label: Mart. 1.22.6
passages.text: Non timeat Dacus Caesaris arma puer.

passages.label: Mart. 1.23.1
passages.text: Invitas nullum nisi cum quo, Cotta, lavaris

passages.label: Mart. 1.23.2
passages.text: Et dant convivam balnea sola tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 1.23.3
passages.text: Mirabar, quare numquam me, Cotta, vocasses:

passages.label: Mart. 1.23.4
passages.text: Iam scio, me nudum displicuisse tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 1.24.1
passages.text: Aspicis incomptis illum, Deciane, capillis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.24.2
passages.text: Cuius et ipse times triste supercilium,

passages.label: Mart. 1.24.3
passages.text: Qui loquitur Curios adsertoresque Camillos?

passages.label: Mart. 1.24.4
passages.text: Nolito fronti credere: nupsit heri.

passages.label: Mart. 1.25.1
passages.text: Ede tuos tandem populo, Faustine, libellos

passages.label: Mart. 1.25.2
passages.text: Et cultum docto pectore profer opus,

passages.label: Mart. 1.25.3
passages.text: Quod nec Cecropiae damnent Pandionis arces

passages.label: Mart. 1.25.4
passages.text: Nec sileant nostri praetereantque senes.

passages.label: Mart. 1.25.5
passages.text: Ante fores stantem dubitas admittere Famam

passages.label: Mart. 1.25.6
passages.text: Teque piget curae praemia ferre tuae?

passages.label: Mart. 1.25.7
passages.text: Post te victurae per te quoque vivere chartae

passages.label: Mart. 1.25.8
passages.text: Incipiant: cineri gloria sera venit.

passages.label: Mart. 1.26.1
passages.text: Sextiliane, bibis quantum subsellia quinque

passages.label: Mart. 1.26.2
passages.text: Solus: aqua totiens ebrius esse potes;

passages.label: Mart. 1.26.3
passages.text: Nec consessorum vicina nomismata tantum,

passages.label: Mart. 1.26.4
passages.text: Aera sed a cuneis ulteriora petis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.26.5
passages.text: Non haec Paelignis agitur vindemia prelis

passages.label: Mart. 1.26.6
passages.text: Uva nec in Tuscis nascitur ista iugis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.26.7
passages.text: Testa sed antiqui felix siccatur Opimi,

passages.label: Mart. 1.26.8
passages.text: Egerit et nigros Massica cella cados.

passages.label: Mart. 1.26.9
passages.text: A copone tibi faex Laletana petatur,

passages.label: Mart. 1.26.10
passages.text: Si plus quam decies, Sextiliane, bibis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.27.1
passages.text: Hesterna tibi nocte dixeramus,

passages.label: Mart. 1.27.2
passages.text: Quincunces puto post decem peractos,

passages.label: Mart. 1.27.3
passages.text: Cenares hodie, Procille, mecum.

passages.label: Mart. 1.27.4
passages.text: Tu factam tibi rem statim putasti

passages.label: Mart. 1.27.5
passages.text: Et non sobria verba subnotasti

passages.label: Mart. 1.27.6
passages.text: Exemplo nimium periculoso:

passages.label: Mart. 1.27.7
passages.text: Μισῶ μνάμονα συμπόταν, Procille.

passages.label: Mart. 1.28.1
passages.text: Hesterno fetere mero qui credit Acerram,

passages.label: Mart. 1.28.2
passages.text: Fallitur: in lucem semper Acerra bibit.

passages.label: Mart. 1.29.1
passages.text: Fama refert nostros te, Fidentine, libellos

passages.label: Mart. 1.29.2
passages.text: Non aliter populo quam recitare tuos.

passages.label: Mart. 1.29.3
passages.text: Si mea vis dici, gratis tibi carmina mittam:

passages.label: Mart. 1.29.4
passages.text: Si dici tua vis, hoc eme, ne mea sint.

passages.label: Mart. 1.30.1
passages.text: Chirurgus fuerat, nunc est vispillo Diaulus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.30.2
passages.text: Coepit quo poterat clinicus esse modo.

passages.label: Mart. 1.31.1
passages.text: Hos tibi, Phoebe, vovet totos a vertice crines

passages.label: Mart. 1.31.2
passages.text: Encolpos, domini centurionis amor,

passages.label: Mart. 1.31.3
passages.text: Grata Pudens meriti tulerit cum praemia pili.

passages.label: Mart. 1.31.4
passages.text: Quam primum longas, Phoebe, recide comas,

passages.label: Mart. 1.31.5
passages.text: Dum nulla teneri sordent lanugine voltus

passages.label: Mart. 1.31.6
passages.text: Dumque decent fusae lactea colla iubae;

passages.label: Mart. 1.31.7
passages.text: Utque tuis longum dominusque puerque fruantur

passages.label: Mart. 1.31.8
passages.text: Muneribus, tonsum fac cito, sero virum.

passages.label: Mart. 1.32.1
passages.text: Non amo te, Sabidi, nec possum dicere quare:

passages.label: Mart. 1.32.2
passages.text: Hoc tantum possum dicere, non amo te.

passages.label: Mart. 1.33.1
passages.text: Amissum non flet cum sola est Gellia patrem,

passages.label: Mart. 1.33.2
passages.text: Si quis adest, iussae prosiliunt lacrimae.

passages.label: Mart. 1.33.3
passages.text: Non luget quisquis laudari, Gellia, quaerit,

passages.label: Mart. 1.33.4
passages.text: Ille dolet vere, qui sine teste dolet.

passages.label: Mart. 1.34.1
passages.text: Incustoditis et apertis, Lesbia, semper

passages.label: Mart. 1.34.2
passages.text: Liminibus peccas nec tua furta tegis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.34.3
passages.text: Et plus spectator quam te delectat adulter

passages.label: Mart. 1.34.4
passages.text: Nec sunt grata tibi gaudia si qua latent.

passages.label: Mart. 1.34.5
passages.text: At meretrix abigit testem veloque seraque

passages.label: Mart. 1.34.6
passages.text: Raraque Submemmi fornice rima patet.

passages.label: Mart. 1.34.7
passages.text: A Chione saltem vel ab Iade disce pudorem:

passages.label: Mart. 1.34.8
passages.text: Abscondunt spurcas et monumenta lupas.

passages.label: Mart. 1.34.9
passages.text: Numquid dura tibi nimium censura videtur?

passages.label: Mart. 1.34.10
passages.text: Deprendi veto te, Lesbia, non futui.

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.1
passages.text: Versus scribere me parum severos

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.2
passages.text: Nec quos praelegat in schola magister,

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.3
passages.text: Corneli, quereris: sed hi libelli,

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.4
passages.text: Tamquam coniugibus suis mariti,

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.5
passages.text: Non possunt sine mentula placere.

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.6
passages.text: Quid si me iubeas talassionem

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.7
passages.text: Verbis dicere non talassionis?

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.8
passages.text: Quis Floralia vestit et stolatum

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.9
passages.text: Permittit meretricibus pudorem?

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.10
passages.text: Lex haec carminibus data est iocosis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.11
passages.text: Ne possint, nisi pruriant, iuvare.

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.12
passages.text: Quare deposita severitate

passages.label: Mart. 1.35.13

passages.text: Non emere librum, sed silentium debet.

passages.label: Mart. 1.67.1
passages.text: 'Liber homo es nimium', dicis mihi, Ceryle, semper.

passages.label: Mart. 1.67.2
passages.text: In te qui dicit, Ceryle, liber homo est?

passages.label: Mart. 1.68.1
passages.text: Quidquid agit Rufus, nihil est nisi Naevia Rufo.

passages.label: Mart. 1.68.2
passages.text: Si gaudet, si flet, si tacet, hanc loquitur.

passages.label: Mart. 1.68.3
passages.text: Cenat, propinat, poscit, negat, innuit: una est

passages.label: Mart. 1.68.4
passages.text: Naevia; si non sit Naevia, mutus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 1.68.5
passages.text: Scriberet hesterna patri cum luce salutem,

passages.label: Mart. 1.68.6
passages.text: 'Naevia lux' inquit 'Naevia lumen, have.'

passages.label: Mart. 1.68.7
passages.text: Haec legit et ridet demisso Naevia voltu.

passages.label: Mart. 1.68.8
passages.text: Naevia non una est: quid, vir inepte, furis?

passages.label: Mart. 1.69.1
passages.text: Coepit, Maxime, Pana quae solebat,

passages.label: Mart. 1.69.2
passages.text: Nunc ostendere Canium Tarentos.

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.1
passages.text: Vade salutatum pro me, liber: ire iuberis

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.2
passages.text: Ad Proculi nitidos, officiose, lares.

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.3
passages.text: Quaeris iter, dicam. Vicinum Castora canae

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.4
passages.text: Transibis Vestae virgineamque domum;

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.5
passages.text: Inde sacro veneranda petes Palatia clivo,

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.6
passages.text: Plurima qua summi fulget imago ducis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.7
passages.text: Nec te detineat miri radiata colossi

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.8
passages.text: Quae Rhodium moles vincere gaudet opus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.9
passages.text: Flecte vias hac qua madidi sunt tecta Lyaei

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.10
passages.text: Et Cybeles picto stat Corybante tholus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.11
passages.text: Protinus a laeva clari tibi fronte Penates

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.12
passages.text: Atriaque excelsae sunt adeunda domus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.13
passages.text: Hanc pete: ne metuas fastus limenque superbum:

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.14
passages.text: Nulla magis toto ianua poste patet,

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.15
passages.text: Nec propior quam Phoebus amet doctaeque sorores.

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.16
passages.text: Si dicet 'Quare non tamen ipse venit?',

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.17
passages.text: Sic licet excuses 'Quia qualiacumque leguntur

passages.label: Mart. 1.70.18
passages.text: Ista, salutator scribere non potuit.'

passages.label: Mart. 1.71.1
passages.text: Laevia sex cyathis, septem Iustina bibatur,

passages.label: Mart. 1.71.2
passages.text: Quinque Lycas, Lyde quattuor, Ida tribus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.71.3
passages.text: Omnis ab infuso numeretur amica Falerno,

passages.label: Mart. 1.71.4
passages.text: Et quia nulla venit, tu mihi, Somne, veni.

passages.label: Mart. 1.72.1
passages.text: Nostris versibus esse te poetam,

passages.label: Mart. 1.72.2
passages.text: Fidentine, putas cupisque credi?

passages.label: Mart. 1.72.3
passages.text: Sic dentata sibi videtur Aegle

passages.label: Mart. 1.72.4
passages.text: Emptis ossibus Indicoque cornu;

passages.label: Mart. 1.72.5
passages.text: Sic quae nigrior est cadente moro,

passages.label: Mart. 1.72.6
passages.text: Cerussata sibi placet Lycoris.

passages.label: Mart. 1.72.7
passages.text: Hac et tu ratione qua poeta es,

passages.label: Mart. 1.72.8
passages.text: Calvus cum fueris, eris comatus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.73.1
passages.text: Nullus in urbe fuit tota qui tangere vellet

passages.label: Mart. 1.73.2
passages.text: Uxorem gratis, Caeciliane, tuam,

passages.label: Mart. 1.73.3
passages.text: Dum licuit: sed nunc positis custodibus ingens

passages.label: Mart. 1.73.4
passages.text: Turba fututorum est: ingeniosus homo es.

passages.label: Mart. 1.74.1
passages.text: Moechus erat: poteras tamen hoc tu, Paula, negare.

passages.label: Mart. 1.74.2
passages.text: Ecce vir est: numquid, Paula, negare potes?

passages.label: Mart. 1.75.1
passages.text: Dimidium donare Lino quam credere totum

passages.label: Mart. 1.75.2
passages.text: Qui mavolt, mavolt perdere dimidium.

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.1
passages.text: O mihi curarum pretium non vile mearum,

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.2
passages.text: Flacce, Antenorei spes et alumne laris,

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.3
passages.text: Pierios differ cantusque chorosque sororum;

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.4
passages.text: Aes dabit ex istis nulla puella tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.5
passages.text: Quid petis a Phoebo? nummos habet arca Minervae;

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.6
passages.text: Haec sapit, haec omnes fenerat una deos.

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.7
passages.text: Quid possunt hederae Bacchi dare? Pallados arbor

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.8
passages.text: Inclinat varias pondere nigra comas.

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.9
passages.text: Praeter aquas Helicon et serta lyrasque dearum

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.10
passages.text: Nil habet et magnum, sed perinane sophos.

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.11
passages.text: Quid tibi cum Cirrha? quid cum Permesside nuda?

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.12
passages.text: Romanum propius divitiusque forum est.

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.13
passages.text: Illic aera sonant: at circum pulpita nostra

passages.label: Mart. 1.76.14
passages.text: Et steriles cathedras basia sola crepant.

passages.label: Mart. 1.77.1
passages.text: Pulchre valet Charinus, et tamen pallet.

passages.label: Mart. 1.77.2
passages.text: Parce bibit Charinus, et tamen pallet.

passages.label: Mart. 1.77.3
passages.text: Bene concoquit Charinus, et tamen pallet.

passages.label: Mart. 1.77.4
passages.text: Sole utitur Charinus, et tamen pallet.

passages.label: Mart. 1.77.5
passages.text: Tingit cutem Charinus, et tamen pallet.

passages.label: Mart. 1.77.6
passages.text: Cunnum Charinus lingit, et tamen pallet.

passages.label: Mart. 1.78.1
passages.text: Indignas premeret pestis cum tabida fauces

passages.label: Mart. 1.78.2
passages.text: Inque ipsos vultus serperet atra lues,

passages.label: Mart. 1.78.3
passages.text: Siccis ipse genis flentes hortatus amicos

passages.label: Mart. 1.78.4
passages.text: Decrevit Stygios Festus adire lacus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.78.5
passages.text: Nec tamen obscuro pia polluit ora veneno

passages.label: Mart. 1.78.6
passages.text: Aut torsit lenta tristia fata fame,

passages.label: Mart. 1.78.7
passages.text: Sanctam Romana vitam sed morte peregit

passages.label: Mart. 1.78.8
passages.text: Dimisitque animam nobiliore rogo.

passages.label: Mart. 1.78.9
passages.text: Hanc mortem fatis magni praeferre Catonis

passages.label: Mart. 1.78.10
passages.text: Fama potest: huius Caesar amicus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 1.79.1
passages.text: Semper agis causas et res agis, Attale, semper:

passages.label: Mart. 1.79.2
passages.text: Est, non est quod agas, Attale, semper agis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.79.3
passages.text: Si res et causae desunt, agis, Attale, mulas.

passages.label: Mart. 1.79.4
passages.text: Attale, ne quod agas desit, agas animam.

passages.label: Mart. 1.80.1
passages.text: Sportula, Cane, tibi suprema nocte petita est

passages.label: Mart. 1.80.2
passages.text: Occidit puto te, Cane, quod una fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 1.81.1
passages.text: A servo scis te genitum blandeque fateris,

passages.label: Mart. 1.81.2
passages.text: Cum dicis dominum, Sosibiane, patrem.

passages.label: Mart. 1.82.1
passages.text: Haec quae pulvere dissipata multo

passages.label: Mart. 1.82.2
passages.text: Longas porticus explicat ruinas,

passages.label: Mart. 1.82.3
passages.text: En quanto iacet absoluta casu.

passages.label: Mart. 1.82.4
passages.text: Tectis nam modo Regulus sub illis

passages.label: Mart. 1.82.5
passages.text: Gestatus fuerat recesseratque,

passages.label: Mart. 1.82.6
passages.text: Victa est pondere cum suo repente,

passages.label: Mart. 1.82.7
passages.text: Et postquam domino nihil timebat,

passages.label: Mart. 1.82.8
passages.text: Securo ruit incruenta damno.

passages.label: Mart. 1.82.9
passages.text: Tantae, Regule, post metum querellae

passages.label: Mart. 1.82.10
passages.text: Quis curam neget esse te deorum,

passages.label: Mart. 1.82.11
passages.text: Propter quem fuit innocens ruina?

passages.label: Mart. 1.83.1
passages.text: Os et labra tibi lingit, Manneia, catellus:

passages.label: Mart. 1.83.2
passages.text: Non miror, merdas si libet esse cani.

passages.label: Mart. 1.84.1
passages.text: Uxorem habendam non putat Quirinalis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.84.2
passages.text: Cum velit habere filios, et invenit

passages.label: Mart. 1.84.3
passages.text: Quo possit istud more: futuit ancillas

passages.label: Mart. 1.84.4
passages.text: Domumque et agros implet equitibus vernis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.84.5
passages.text: Pater familiae verus est Quirinalis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.85.1
passages.text: Venderet excultos colles cum praeco facetus

passages.label: Mart. 1.85.2
passages.text: Atque suburbani iugera pulchra soli,

passages.label: Mart. 1.85.3
passages.text: 'Errat' ait 'si quis Mario putat esse necesse

passages.label: Mart. 1.85.4
passages.text: Vendere: nil debet, fenerat immo magis.'

passages.label: Mart. 1.85.5
passages.text: 'Quae ratio est igitur?' 'Servos ibi perdidit omnes

passages.label: Mart. 1.85.6
passages.text: Et pecus et fructus, non amat inde locum.'

passages.label: Mart. 1.85.7
passages.text: Quis faceret pretium nisi qui sua perdere vellet

passages.label: Mart. 1.85.8
passages.text: Omnia? Sic Mario noxius haeret ager.

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.1
passages.text: Vicinus meus est manuque tangi

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.2
passages.text: De nostris Novius potest fenestris.

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.3
passages.text: Quis non invideat mihi putetque

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.4
passages.text: Horis omnibus esse me beatum,

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.5
passages.text: Iuncto cui liceat frui sodale?

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.6
passages.text: Tam longe est mihi quam Terentianus,

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.7
passages.text: Qui nunc Niliacam regit Syenen.

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.8
passages.text: Non convivere, nec videre saltem,

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.9
passages.text: Non audire licet, nec urbe tota

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.10
passages.text: Quisquam est tam prope tam proculque nobis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.11
passages.text: Migrandum est mihi longius vel illi.

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.12
passages.text: Vicinus Novio vel inquilinus

passages.label: Mart. 1.86.13
passages.text: Sit, si quis Novium videre non volt.

passages.label: Mart. 1.87.1
passages.text: Ne gravis hesterno fragres, Fescennia, vino,

passages.label: Mart. 1.87.2
passages.text: Pastillos Cosmi luxuriosa voras.

passages.label: Mart. 1.87.3
passages.text: Ista linunt dentes iantacula, sed nihil obstant,

passages.label: Mart. 1.87.4
passages.text: Extremo ructus cum redit a barathro.

passages.label: Mart. 1.87.5
passages.text: Quid quod olet gravius mixtum diapasmate virus

passages.label: Mart. 1.87.6
passages.text: Atque duplex animae longius exit odor?

passages.label: Mart. 1.87.7
passages.text: Notas ergo nimis fraudes deprensaque furta

passages.label: Mart. 1.87.8
passages.text: Iam tollas et sis ebria simpliciter.

passages.label: Mart. 1.88.1
passages.text: Alcime, quem raptum domino crescentibus annis

passages.label: Mart. 1.88.2
passages.text: Labicana levi caespite velat humus,

passages.label: Mart. 1.88.3
passages.text: Accipe non Pario nutantia pondera saxo,

passages.label: Mart. 1.88.4
passages.text: Quae cineri vanus dat ruitura labor,

passages.label: Mart. 1.88.5
passages.text: Sed faciles buxos et opacas palmitis umbras

passages.label: Mart. 1.88.6
passages.text: Quaeque virent lacrimis roscida prata meis

passages.label: Mart. 1.88.7
passages.text: Accipe, care puer, nostri monimenta doloris:

passages.label: Mart. 1.88.8
passages.text: Hic tibi perpetuo tempore vivet honor.

passages.label: Mart. 1.88.9
passages.text: Cum mihi supremos Lachesis pervenerit annos,

passages.label: Mart. 1.88.10
passages.text: Non aliter cineres mando iacere meos.

passages.label: Mart. 1.89.1
passages.text: Garris in aurem semper omnibus, Cinna,

passages.label: Mart. 1.89.2
passages.text: Garrire et illud teste quod licet turba.

passages.label: Mart. 1.89.3
passages.text: Rides in aurem, quereris, arguis, ploras,

passages.label: Mart. 1.89.4
passages.text: Cantas in aurem, iudicas, taces, clamas,

passages.label: Mart. 1.89.5
passages.text: Adeoque penitus sedit hic tibi morbus,

passages.label: Mart. 1.89.6
passages.text: Ut saepe in aurem, Cinna, Caesarem laudes.

passages.label: Mart. 1.90.1
passages.text: Quod numquam maribus iunctam te, Bassa, videbam

passages.label: Mart. 1.90.2
passages.text: Quodque tibi moechum fabula nulla dabat,

passages.label: Mart. 1.90.3
passages.text: Omne sed officium circa te semper obibat

passages.label: Mart. 1.90.4
passages.text: Turba tui sexus, non adeunte viro,

passages.label: Mart. 1.90.5
passages.text: Esse videbaris, fateor, Lucretia nobis:

passages.label: Mart. 1.90.6
passages.text: At tu, pro facinus, Bassa, fututor eras.

passages.label: Mart. 1.90.7
passages.text: Inter se geminos audes committere cunnos

passages.label: Mart. 1.90.8
passages.text: Mentiturque virum prodigiosa Venus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.90.9
passages.text: Commenta es dignum Thebano aenigmate monstrum,

passages.label: Mart. 1.90.10
passages.text: Hic ubi vir non est, ut sit adulterium.

passages.label: Mart. 1.91.1
passages.text: Cum tua non edas, carpis mea carmina, Laeli.

passages.label: Mart. 1.91.2
passages.text: Carpere vel noli nostra vel ede tua.

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.1
passages.text: Saepe mihi queritur non siccis Cestos ocellis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.2
passages.text: Tangi se digito, Mamuriane, tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.3
passages.text: Non opus est digito: totum tibi Ceston habeto,

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.4
passages.text: Si deest nil aliud, Mamuriane, tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.5
passages.text: Sed si nec focus est nudi nec sponda grabati

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.6
passages.text: Nec curtus Chiones Antiopesve calix,

passages.text: Cerea si pendet lumbis et scripta lacerna

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.8
passages.text: Dimidiasque nates Gallica paeda tegit,

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.9
passages.text: Pasceris et nigrae solo nidore culinae

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.10
passages.text: Et bibis inmundam cum cane pronus aquam:

passages.text: Non culum—neque enim est culus, qui non cacat olim—

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.12
passages.text: Sed fodiam digito qui superest oculum:

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.13
passages.text: Nec me zelotypum nec dixeris esse malignum.

passages.label: Mart. 1.92.14
passages.text: Denique pedica, Mamuriane, satur.

passages.text: Fabricio iunctus fido requiescit Aquinus,

passages.text: Qui prior Elysias gaudet adisse domos.

passages.text: Ara duplex primi testatur munera pili:

passages.text: Plus tamen est, titulo quod breviore legis:

passages.text: 'Iunctus uterque sacro laudatae foedere vitae,

passages.text: Famaque quod raro novit, amicus erat.'

passages.text: Cantasti male, dum fututa es, Aegle.

passages.text: Iam cantas bene; basianda non es.

passages.text: Quod clamas semper, quod agentibus obstrepis, Aeli,

passages.text: Non facis hoc gratis: accipis, ut taceas.

passages.text: Si non molestum est teque non piget, scazon,

passages.text: Nostro rogamus pauca verba Materno

passages.label: Mart. 1.96.3
passages.text: Dicas in aurem sic ut audiat solus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.96.4
passages.text: Amator ille tristium lacernarum

passages.label: Mart. 1.96.5
passages.text: Et baeticatus atque leucophaeatus,

passages.text: Qui coccinatos non putat viros esse

passages.text: Amethystinasque mulierum vocat vestes,

passages.text: Nativa laudet, habeat et licet semper

passages.label: Mart. 1.96.9
passages.text: Fuscos colores, galbinos habet mores.

passages.label: Mart. 1.96.10
passages.text: Rogabit, unde suspicer virum mollem.

passages.text: Una lavamur: aspicit nihil sursum,

passages.text: Sed spectat oculis devorantibus draucos

passages.label: Mart. 1.96.13
passages.text: Nec otiosis mentulas videt labris.

passages.label: Mart. 1.96.14
passages.text: Quaeris quis hic sit? Excidit mihi nomen.

passages.label: Mart. 1.97.1
passages.text: Cum clamant omnes, loqueris tunc, Naevole, tantum,

passages.text: Et te patronum causidicumque putas.

passages.text: Hac ratione potest nemo non esse disertus.

passages.text: Ecce, tacent omnes: Naevole, dic aliquid.

passages.text: Litigat et podagra Diodorus, Flacce, laborat.

passages.text: Et tam lautus eras, Calene, ut omnes

passages.text: Audi=t vota deus precesque nostras

passages.text: Atque intra, puto, septimas Kalendas

passages.text: Ut convivia sumptuosiora,

passages.text: Toto quae semel apparas in anno,

passages.text: Nigrae sordibus explices monetae,

passages.text: Et septem veteres tui sodales

passages.label: Mart. 1.99.15
passages.text: Constemus tibi plumbea selibra.

passages.text: Quid dignum meritis precemur istis?

passages.text: Mammas atque tatas habet Afra, sed ipsa tatarum

passages.text: Ureret inplicitum cum scelerata lues,

passages.label: Mart. 1.101.7
passages.text: Cavimus et domini ius omne remisimus aegro:

passages.label: Mart. 1.101.8
passages.text: Munere dignus erat convaluisse meo.

passages.label: Mart. 1.101.9
passages.text: Sensit deficiens sua praemia meque patronum

passages.label: Mart. 1.101.10
passages.text: Dixit ad infernas liber iturus aquas.

passages.label: Mart. 1.102.1
passages.text: Qui pinxit Venerem tuam, Lycori,

passages.label: Mart. 1.102.2
passages.text: Blanditus, puto, pictor est Minervae.

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.1
passages.text: 'Si dederint superi decies mihi milia centum'

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.2
passages.text: Dicebas nondum, Scaevola, iustus eques,

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.3
passages.text: 'Qualiter o vivam, quam large quamque beate!'

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.4
passages.text: Riserunt faciles et tribuere dei.

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.5
passages.text: Sordidior multo post hoc toga, paenula peior,

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.6
passages.text: Calceus est sarta terque quaterque cute:

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.7
passages.text: Deque decem plures semper servantur olivae,

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.8
passages.text: Explicat et cenas unica mensa duas,

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.9
passages.text: Et Veientani bibitur faex crassa rubelli,

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.10
passages.text: Asse cicer tepidum constat et asse Venus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.11
passages.text: In ius, o fallax atque infitiator, eamus:

passages.label: Mart. 1.103.12
passages.text: Aut vive aut decies, Scaevola, redde deis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.1
passages.text: Picto quod iuga delicata collo

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.2
passages.text: Pardus sustinet inprobaeque tigres

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.3
passages.text: Indulgent patientiam flagello,

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.4
passages.text: Mordent aurea quod lupata cervi,

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.5
passages.text: Quod frenis Libyci domantur ursi

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.6
passages.text: Et, quantum Calydon tulisse fertur,

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.7
passages.text: Paret purpureis aper capistris,

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.8
passages.text: Turpes esseda quod trahunt visontes

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.9
passages.text: Et molles dare iussa quod choreas

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.10
passages.text: Nigro belua non negat magistro:

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.11
passages.text: Quis spectacula non putet deorum?

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.12
passages.text: Haec transit tamen, ut minora, quisquis

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.13
passages.text: Venatus humiles videt leonum,

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.14
passages.text: Quos velox leporum timor fatigat.

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.15
passages.text: Dimittunt, repetunt, amantque captos,

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.16
passages.text: Et securior est in ore praeda,

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.17
passages.text: Laxos cui dare perviosque rictus

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.18
passages.text: Gaudent et timidos tenere dentes,

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.19
passages.text: Mollem frangere dum pudet rapinam,

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.20
passages.text: Stratis cum modo venerint iuvencis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.21
passages.text: Haec clementia non paratur arte,

passages.label: Mart. 1.104.22
passages.text: Sed norunt cui+ serviant leones.

passages.label: Mart. 1.105.1
passages.text: In Nomentanis, Ovidi, quod nascitur arvis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.105.2
passages.text: Accepit quotiens tempora longa, merum

passages.label: Mart. 1.105.3
passages.text: Exuit annosa mores nomenque senecta:

passages.label: Mart. 1.105.4
passages.text: Et quidquid voluit, testa vocatur anus.

passages.label: Mart. 1.106.1
passages.text: Interponis aquam subinde, Rufe,

passages.label: Mart. 1.106.2
passages.text: Et si cogeris a sodale, raram

passages.label: Mart. 1.106.3
passages.text: Diluti bibis unciam Falerni.

passages.label: Mart. 1.106.4
passages.text: Numquid pollicita est tibi beatam

passages.label: Mart. 1.106.5
passages.text: Noctem Naevia sobriasque mavis

passages.label: Mart. 1.106.6
passages.text: Certae nequitias fututionis?

passages.label: Mart. 1.106.7
passages.text: Suspiras, retices, gemis: negavit.

passages.label: Mart. 1.106.8
passages.text: Crebros ergo licet bibas trientes

passages.label: Mart. 1.106.9
passages.text: Et durum iugules mero dolorem.

passages.label: Mart. 1.106.10
passages.text: Quid parcis tibi, Rufe? dormiendum est.

passages.label: Mart. 1.107.1
passages.text: Saepe mihi dicis, Luci carissime Iuli,

passages.label: Mart. 1.107.2
passages.text: 'Scribe aliquid magnum: desidiosus homo es.'

passages.label: Mart. 1.107.3
passages.text: Otia da nobis, sed qualia fecerat olim

passages.label: Mart. 1.107.4
passages.text: Maecenas Flacco Vergilioque suo:

passages.label: Mart. 1.107.5
passages.text: Condere victuras temptem per saecula curas

passages.label: Mart. 1.107.6
passages.text: Et nomen flammis eripuisse meum.

passages.label: Mart. 1.107.7
passages.text: In steriles nolunt campos iuga ferre iuvenci:

passages.label: Mart. 1.107.8
passages.text: Pingue solum lassat, sed iuvat ipse labor.

passages.label: Mart. 1.108.1
passages.text: Est tibi—sitque precor multos crescatque per annos—

passages.label: Mart. 1.108.2
passages.text: Pulchra quidem, verum transtiberina domus:

passages.label: Mart. 1.108.3
passages.text: At mea Vipsanas spectant cenacula laurus,

passages.label: Mart. 1.108.4
passages.text: Factus in hac ego sum iam regione senex.

passages.label: Mart. 1.108.5
passages.text: Migrandum est, ut mane domi te, Galle, salutem:

passages.label: Mart. 1.108.6
passages.text: Est tanti, vel si longius illa foret.

passages.label: Mart. 1.108.7
passages.text: Sed tibi non multum est, unum si praesto togatum:

passages.label: Mart. 1.108.8
passages.text: Multum est hunc unum si mihi, Galle, nego.

passages.label: Mart. 1.108.9
passages.text: Ipse salutabo decuma te saepius hora:

passages.label: Mart. 1.108.10
passages.text: Mane tibi pro me dicet havere liber.

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.1
passages.text: Issa est passere nequior Catulli,

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.2
passages.text: Issa est purior osculo columbae,

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.3
passages.text: Issa est blandior omnibus puellis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.4
passages.text: Issa est carior Indicis lapillis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.5
passages.text: Issa est deliciae catella Publi.

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.6
passages.text: Hanc tu, si queritur, loqui putabis;

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.7
passages.text: Sentit tristitiamque gaudiumque.

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.8
passages.text: Collo nixa cubat capitque somnos,

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.9
passages.text: Ut suspiria nulla sentiantur;

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.10
passages.text: Et desiderio coacta ventris

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.11
passages.text: Gutta pallia non fefellit ulla,

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.12
passages.text: Sed blando pede suscitat toroque

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.13
passages.text: Deponi monet et rogat levari.

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.14
passages.text: Castae tantus inest pudor catellae,

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.15
passages.text: Ignorat Venerem; nec invenimus

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.16
passages.text: Dignum tam tenera virum puella.

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.17
passages.text: Hanc ne lux rapiat suprema totam,

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.18
passages.text: Picta Publius exprimit tabella,

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.19
passages.text: In qua tam similem videbis Issam,

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.20
passages.text: Ut sit tam similis sibi nec ipsa.

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.21
passages.text: Issam denique pone cum tabella:

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.22
passages.text: Aut utramque putabis esse veram,

passages.label: Mart. 1.109.23
passages.text: Aut utramque putabis esse pictam.

passages.label: Mart. 1.110.1
passages.text: Scribere me quereris, Velox, epigrammata longa.

passages.label: Mart. 1.110.2
passages.text: Ipse nihil scribis: tu breviora facis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.111.1
passages.text: Cum tibi sit sophiae par fama et cura deorum,

passages.label: Mart. 1.111.2
passages.text: Ingenio pietas nec minor ipsa suo:

passages.label: Mart. 1.111.3
passages.text: Ignorat meritis dare munera, qui tibi librum

passages.label: Mart. 1.111.4
passages.text: Et qui miratur, Regule, tura dari.

passages.label: Mart. 1.112.1
passages.text: Cum te non nossem, dominum regemque vocabam:

passages.label: Mart. 1.112.2
passages.text: Nunc bene te novi: iam mihi Priscus eris.

passages.label: Mart. 1.113.1
passages.text: Quaecumque lusi iuvenis et puer quondam

passages.label: Mart. 1.113.2
passages.text: Apinasque nostras, quas nec ipse iam novi,

passages.label: Mart. 1.113.3
passages.text: Male conlocare si bonas voles horas

passages.label: Mart. 1.113.4
passages.text: Et invidebis otio tuo, lector,

passages.label: Mart. 1.113.5
passages.text: A Valeriano Pollio petes Quinto,

passages.label: Mart. 1.113.6
passages.text: Per quem perire non licet meis nugis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.114.1
passages.text: Hos tibi vicinos, Faustine, Telesphorus hortos

passages.label: Mart. 1.114.2
passages.text: Faenius et breve rus udaque prata tenet.

passages.label: Mart. 1.114.3
passages.text: Condidit hic natae cineres nomenque sacravit

passages.label: Mart. 1.114.4
passages.text: Quod legis Antullae, dignior ipse legi.

passages.label: Mart. 1.114.5
passages.text: Ad Stygias aequum fuerat pater isset ut umbras:

passages.label: Mart. 1.114.6
passages.text: Quod quia non licuit, vivat, ut ossa colat.

passages.label: Mart. 1.115.1
passages.text: Quaedam me cupit—invide, Procille!—

passages.label: Mart. 1.115.2
passages.text: Loto candidior puella cycno,

passages.label: Mart. 1.115.3
passages.text: Argento, nive, lilio, ligustro.

passages.label: Mart. 1.115.4
passages.text: Sed quandam volo nocte nigriorem,

passages.label: Mart. 1.115.5
passages.text: Formica, pice, graculo, cicada.

passages.label: Mart. 1.115.6
passages.text: Iam suspendia saeva cogitabas:

passages.label: Mart. 1.115.7
passages.text: Si novi bene te, Procille, vives.

passages.label: Mart. 1.116.1
passages.text: Hoc nemus aeterno cinerum sacravit honori

passages.label: Mart. 1.116.2
passages.text: Faenius et culti iugera pulchra soli.

passages.label: Mart. 1.116.3
passages.text: Hoc tegitur cito rapta suis Antulla sepulchro,

passages.label: Mart. 1.116.4
passages.text: Hoc erit Antullae mixtus uterque parens.

passages.label: Mart. 1.116.5
passages.text: Si cupit hunc aliquis, moneo, ne speret agellum:

passages.label: Mart. 1.116.6
passages.text: Perpetuo dominis serviet iste suis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.1
passages.text: Occurris quotiens, Luperce, nobis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.2
passages.text: 'Vis mittam puerum' subinde dicis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.3
passages.text: 'Cui tradas epigrammaton libellum,

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.4
passages.text: Lectum quem tibi protinus remittam?'

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.5
passages.text: Non est quod puerum, Luperce, vexes.

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.6
passages.text: Longum est, si velit ad Pirum venire,

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.7
passages.text: Et scalis habito tribus, sed altis.

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.8
passages.text: Quod quaeris propius petas licebit.

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.9
passages.text: Argi nempe soles subire letum:

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.10
passages.text: Contra Caesaris est forum taberna

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.11
passages.text: Scriptis postibus hinc et inde totis,

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.12
passages.text: Omnis ut cito perlegas poetas.

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.13
passages.text: Illinc me pete. Nec roges Atrectum

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.14
passages.text: —Hoc nomen dominus gerit tabernae—:

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.15
passages.text: De primo dabit alterove nido

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.16
passages.text: Rasum pumice purpuraque cultum

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.17
passages.text: Denaris tibi quinque Martialem.

passages.label: Mart. 1.117.18
passages.text: 'Tanti non es' ais? Sapis, Luperce.

passages.label: Mart. 1.118.1
passages.text: Cui legisse satis non est epigrammata centum,

passages.label: Mart. 1.118.2
passages.text: Nil illi satis est, Caediciane, mali.
